title: Doesn’t fit good for me, or I’m doing something wrong!
text:
Doesn’t fit good for me, or I’m doing something wrong!. I measured my club chair to make sure this cover would fit!
I ordered the gray, I like the color. It’s not dark, or too light.
It’s also kind of shiny.
It’s a little tricky putting this cover on, so look at the directions.
The big thick elastic part goes under and behind the cushion.

We are having a hard time getting this to fit smooth, and to stay
Tuck in , in the back of the cushion, and the rollers I can see, and
it doesn’t look good, or we are doing something wrong !
I have to say my Cushion lifts up in the back, but does not come
Off the chair, that could be my problem , although would
Like to hear if that was anyone else’s?

The way the cover fits now is useless to me.
2 star.
